# Image Provenance

The images in this directory are generated/captured by following the steps in
[.github/prompts/capture-what-is-mam-slides.prompt.md](../../../.github/prompts/capture-what-is-mam-slides.prompt.md).

- `slide-title-card.png` and `slide-closing-card.png` are rendered directly by
  `py/main_slide_generator.py render-slides --deck what-is-mam`, which also writes `*-provenance.md`
  files next to each of them.
- The remaining `slide-*.png` files are browser screenshots captured manually
  (or via the agent prompt above).
- All `thumb-*.png` files are generated from their corresponding `slide-*.png`
  by `py/main_slide_generator.py make-thumbs --deck what-is-mam`.
